text: 周四（10月29日），沙特证交所全股指数收跌1.02%，报9921.50点，结束此前连续三个交易日反弹的趋势，10月25日曾跌至9438.50点——创2021年3月25日（收报9417.71点）以来收盘最低位，本周累计上涨2.33%。 沙特阿美收跌0.31%，报25.92沙特里亚尔，本周累涨2.05%。 在沙特上市的Albilad南方东英MSCI香港中国股票ETF收涨0.18%，报10.91沙特里亚尔，10月22日重挫4.25%以来低位企稳，本周累涨0.93%。
text_en: Thursday (Oct 29): the Saudi Stock Exchange Tadawul All Share Index closed down 1.02% at 9,921.50 points, ending a three-session rebound; on Oct 25 it had fallen to 9,438.50 points, its lowest close since March 25, 2021 (9,417.71 points); up 2.33% this week. Saudi Aramco closed down 0.31% at SAR 25.92, up 2.05% this week. The Albilad CSOP MSCI Hong Kong China Equity ETF listed in Saudi Arabia closed up 0.18% at SAR 10.91, stabilizing at lows after a 4.25% slump on Oct 22, up 0.93% this week.
